question: Within 50 kilometers, where can I find a gallery aligned with the route to Safari West, Sant Rosa, CA from the St. Regis San Francisco, San Francisco, CA?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'gallery' AND ST_Intersects( geometry::geography, ( SELECT ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%St. Regis San Francisco%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Safari West%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Santa Rosa%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 50000 ) ) );
